summary: First-pass full-stack testing of VIEARTA. All 12 backend pytest cases passed (auth, checkins upsert + week series, recommendations personalization, events, learning, rotating message, 401 protection). Frontend E2E via Playwright validated: login (demo button), home dashboard renders with Jaylen/ANCRID-7G8X/tagline, arriving check-in save, creative demand save, 3 recommendation cards, 4 upcoming events, continue-learning button, 5 weekly metric toggles, 7 quick-access buttons, navigation to /check-in (detailed page save works), placeholder page shows Coming soon, logout clears viearta_token and redirects to /login, protected route redirects to /login when unauthenticated.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits repeated console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' during initial render. Not a blocker but should give the container an explicit minHeight or aspect ratio.

action_items: (Low) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer sizing warnings in WeeklyPattern by giving parent an explicit height / minHeight, or set aspect.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes concerns (auth, models, seed, routes) in ~700 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth.py, models.py, seed.py, routers/) as the app grows.
CORS uses allow_origins from env (currently '*') with allow_credentials=False — fine for token-in-header auth but tighten origins before production.
JWT_EXP is 7 days for demo simplicity — acceptable for first pass, should shorten with refresh token flow later.
Seed runs on every startup and re-inserts events/learning after delete_many — check-ins are upserted so history preserved. OK for demo but noisy for prod.
No pagination or filtering on events/learning; fine at current data volume.
No rate limiting / brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout — not implemented).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seed is idempotent (upsert). Token key is 'viearta_token' in localStorage. All required data-testids exist. If chart warnings addressed, verify no regression to metric toggles.
